patchDecisions.app: All seven app patches remain needed. Browser, capability/hook/policy, publisher and theme logic moved into Rspack module factories. Native main-process functions and membership/utility boundaries also changed. New exact-hash revisions and source fixtures execute those functions without starting the app.
patchDecisions.runtime: All four runtime patches remain needed with bundled CLI 0.166.0-alpha.6; current stock native regressions were reproduced and patched outcomes verified.
patchDecisions.pet: The stock loader still joins Windows home using POSIX semantics; patched actual-source discovery, selection, installation, collision and traversal cases pass.
patchDecisions.security: Native workspace/authorization/provider restrictions, Work denials/account-switch rechecks, API-key/authenticated identities, latest disables and active turns remain covered. Upstream now enforces remote audio denial in the final config generator, and that boundary is tested directly.
patchDecisions.retired: GraphQL shell guard and pet-home aliases remain retired; native quoting passes the actual Windows Node to wsl.exe boundary.

hostedEvidence.reason: The official WSL runtime could not initialize/update on that hosted image. This older-package run is not acceptance for the current Store build.

limitations: No generated app copy was activated; the app was not restarted and saved settings/data were not changed.
Current-build Application Control permission, startup, desktop theme, interactive pets, actual agent Browser/Computer Use, authenticated connector inventory and real-phone reconnect remain pending.
Existing Application Control and initial theme mismatch observations remain documented. Android project-label display remains a separate accepted limitation.
Local WSL2 passes do not establish a new hosted WSL2 pass.
